description:
The Mongoose 12" Expo Scooter is designed to offer hours of fun and exercise to young people regardless of where they live. The Expo features 12" inflatable tires that can handle a variety of surfaces, such as dirt and grass, and BMX freestyle brake rotor and axle pegs allowing riders to perform a multitude of tricks. Rip around the neighborhood or to local parks and trails on the Expo Scooter!
Scooter with a wide foot deck for added balance and stability while coasting.
BMX freestyle brake rotor and axle pegs make for a trick-ready scooter.
Alloy caliper hand brakes offer intuitive speed control.
12" air tires perform well when riding on paved and unpaved surfaces, such as dirt and grass.
